headline: Chinese Automakers Face Marketing Scrutiny Amid Slowing Sales
summary: Chinese carmakers face increased controversy over marketing tactics and regulatory quality checks as sales growth slows.
why: The Chinese automotive market is intensely competitive, and rising scrutiny on marketing practices and vehicle reliability can impact brand equity and regulatory oversight for major manufacturers.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Stricter regulatory quality checks and marketing controversies affect domestic carmakers facing slowing sales.
